name: simpld-desktop
author: Yashneil Gajjala
description: Simpld desktop app: React frontend + Python FastAPI backend + Electron shell

scripts.backend:build: pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean --name simpld-backend --onedir --console --distpath dist-backend --workpath build-backend --hidden-import requests --collect-all llama_cpp --collect-all llama_cpp_python --exclude-module torch --exclude-module torchvision --exclude-module torchaudio --exclude-module torchdata --exclude-module torchao --exclude-module triton --exclude-module bitsandbytes --exclude-module pygame --exclude-module django --exclude-module langchain --exclude-module langchain_classic --exclude-module langchain_community --exclude-module langchain_core --exclude-module transformers --exclude-module diffusers --exclude-module accelerate --exclude-module sklearn --exclude-module scipy --exclude-module pandas --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module nltk --exclude-module librosa --exclude-module datasets --exclude-module playwright --exclude-module onnxruntime --exclude-module numba --exclude-module llvmlite --exclude-module pyarrow --exclude-module duckdb --exclude-module lxml --exclude-module pdfminer --exclude-module pypdfium2 --exclude-module imageio --exclude-module sqlalchemy --exclude-module psycopg2 --exclude-module grpc --exclude-module sentry_sdk --exclude-module gevent --exclude-module tkinter --exclude-module cv2 backend_main.py
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON -c blue,green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend:dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health && npm run electron:dev"
scripts.dist: npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:build && electron-builder
